tests.detail: one prediction mutation changes deterministic body hash
rank 1 changed to 2 creates nonconsecutive ranks
side-specific multiset comparison rejects reversed reaction
eligibility gate rejects product-only even if strings were supplied

interpretation_limits: This is a six-valid-case sanity/challenge pilot whose answers may occur in public model training data.
Route C-exact is database lookup, not novel reaction generalization.
Route A has no defensible native rank or confidence and is not Top-K scored.
Route B model/version labels are user supplied and not platform-attested.
Product recovery does not equal full biochemical reaction recovery.
A nonempty D4-valid enzyme pool does not establish that a correct enzyme is present or ranked first.
No final route selection is made by this scoring report.

parsable_subset_diagnostic_not_formal_sc.warning: Unparseable raw products were not repaired and were excluded only from this explicitly non-formal diagnostic.

target_candidate_enzyme_pool_recoverabil.semantics: Correct target Rhea recovered and frozen Rhea-to-UniProt mapping intersects complete D4 assets; does not assert a correct enzyme or rank.

target_rhea_ec_mapping.semantics: Availability from frozen rhea2ec.tsv after correct directed-Rhea recovery; not an independent EC prediction accuracy test.
